overview: The 2026 manual reflects two decades of new laws and technology, most notably stricter cell phone rules (a hands-free requirement and a total ban for drivers under 18), new REAL ID and Standard license options, and tougher Junior Operator requirements including far more supervised and in-car driving hours. Drivers should also review expanded protections for cyclists and pedestrians—such as the Vulnerable Road Users four-foot passing law, the Dutch Reach door-opening method, bike lanes and boxes, the Move-Over Law, the White Cane Law, and new traffic signals and pavement markings. Several brand-new safety topics appear as well, including Advanced Driver Assistance Systems, drowsy driving, tunnel driving, recommended car safety kits, proper backing-up technique, and updated breakdown procedures using safety vests and warning triangles. Finally, expect updated fines, surcharges, and penalties across the board, along with changes to OUI rules, child restraint and following-distance standards, road test procedures, and the at-fault crash and driver retraining thresholds.

sections.title: REAL ID and Standard Massachusetts Cards
sections.description: The 2026 manual introduces a choice between a REAL ID and a Standard Massachusetts driver's license/ID, a federal distinction not present in 2006.
bullets: "You need to choose either a REAL ID Massachusetts Driver’s License or ID Card or a Standard Massachusetts Driver’s License or ID Card." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"A REAL ID Card issued by Massachusetts is compliant with the federal REAL ID Act of 2005." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Out-of-Country Driving Violation Penalty
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds that violating the foreign-license driving provision (Section 10) is a criminal violation with a first-offense fine.
bullets: "A violation of Section 10 is a criminal violation and a first offense is subject to a fine of $500." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Driver Education Requirements for JOL
sections.description: The driver education and supervised driving requirements increased from 6 to 12 hours of in-car training and from 12 to 40 hours of supervised driving, plus new parent instruction requirements.
bullets: "Successfully complete an RMV-approved driver education and training program, which includes 30 hours of classroom instruction; 12 hours of in-car, behind-the-wheel training; and six hours of in-car experience observing other student drivers." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"Complete at least an additional 40 hours of supervised, behind-the­ wheel driving as shown by a certified statement provided by a parent or guardian." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

"A parent or guardian must participate in two hours of instruction on the driver’s education curriculum (unless they have participated within the past five years)." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: JOL Night Driving Restriction Time
sections.description: The Junior Operator night driving curfew start time changed from 12:00 a.m. (2006) to 12:30 a.m. (2026).
bullets: "As the holder of a JOL, you may not operate a motor vehicle between 12:30 a.m. and 5:00 a.m. unless you are accompanied by one of your parents or your legal guardian." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

"The law states that between 12:30 a.m. and 1:00 a.m. and between 4:00 a.m. and 5:00 a.m., the provisions of the law shall be enforced by law enforcement agencies only when a Junior Operator of a motor vehicle has been lawfully stopped" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: JOL Passenger/Night Restriction Penalties
sections.description: The suspension periods for violating JOL restrictions increased from 30/60/90 days (2006) to 60/180 days/one year (2026), with an added retraining course requirement.
bullets: "If you violate the passenger restriction or the night restriction, you will be subject to a license suspension of 60 days for a first offense, 180 days for a second offense, and one year for subsequent offenses." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"For a second or subsequent offense, you will also be required to complete a Driver Attitudinal Retraining course." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: JOL Speeding and Drag Racing Suspension Periods
sections.description: The 2026 manual specifies different suspension periods for drag racing (one year first/three years subsequent) and speeding (90 days first/one year subsequent) than the 2006 edition.
bullets: "You will face additional suspension periods of one year for a first drag racing offense and three years for a subsequent offense. For a first speeding offense, you will be suspended for 90 days; for a subsequent offense, you will be suspended for one year." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Mobile Device Ban for Drivers Under 18
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a prohibition on any mobile electronic device use by drivers under 18, not present in the 2006 edition.
bullets: "Drivers under 18 may not use any mobile electronic device for any reason while operating a motor vehicle . The only exception is for reporting an emergency." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"Drivers under 18 cannot use any mobile electronic device for any reason while driving. The only exception is for reporting an emergency." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: State-to-State License Verification Program
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds the State-to-State program and the rule against holding licenses in multiple states.
bullets: "You cannot hold a driver's license in multiple states. Massachusetts is part of the State-to-State program, which checks valid driver licenses and state issued ID cards issued by other participating states." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Vertical License for Under-21 Applicants
sections.description: The 2026 manual introduces a vertical license/ID format for applicants under 21, not in the 2006 edition.
bullets: "If you renew your license or ID card before your 21st birthday, you will receive a vertical license or ID card ." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Prorated License Length Based on Lawful Presence
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds rules allowing REAL ID licenses to be issued for less than five years based on authorized lawful presence.
bullets: "A REAL ID License or ID card can be issued for a period of less than five years if an applicant’s authorized lawful presence (as established by the U.S. Department of Homeland Security) is for a shorter period." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Expanded List of License Restriction Codes
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds many new restriction codes (e.g., medical log/glucose, bioptic telescoping lens, ignition interlock, CDL-specific) beyond the 2006 list.
bullets: "2 Medical Log / Glucose Required" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"R Bioptic Telescoping Lens" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"T Ignition Interlock" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Electronic Identification Document Verification
sections.description: The 2026 manual describes a new electronic document verification process with national and state databases.
bullets: "The Registry will initiate electronic checks for most identification documents with national and state databases. This process provides validity responses back to the RMV within seconds for the vast majority." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: No Social Security Number Affidavit Option
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a No Social Security Number Affidavit option for certain Standard Driver's License applicants.
bullets: "A No Social Security Number Affidavit - only allowed for certain customers presenting specific document types and only for Standard Driver's Licenses (NOT for Massachusetts ID Cards)" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"If you do not have an SSN and cannot apply for one, you can present a No Social Security Number Affidavit and apply for a Standard Driver's License" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Vision Screening Certificate Provider Requirement
sections.description: The 2026 manual requires the Vision Screening Certificate to be completed by an ophthalmologist or optometrist, whereas 2006 specified a physician or optometrist licensed in Massachusetts.
bullets: "you may submit an original RMV Vision Screening Certificate (VSC) that your ophthalmologist or optometrist has completed." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: SSN Denial Notice Requirements
sections.description: The SSN denial notice age was extended from 30 days to 60 days, and additional documents are now required.
bullets: "you must present the written Denial Notice (not more than 60 days old) the SSA provided you and all of the following:" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Appeals Filing Timeframe
sections.description: The appeal filing fee remains $50 but the address and contact details for the Board of Appeals changed.
bullets: "One Federal St., Suite 700 • Boston, MA 02110 617-521-7794 • State.Ma.US/DOI" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Learner's Permit Exam Format
sections.description: The exam was expanded from 20 questions requiring 14 correct in 20 minutes to 25 questions requiring 18 correct in 25 minutes.
bullets: "Each learner’s permit exam has 25 multiple-choice questions." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"To pass the exam, you must answer 18 questions correctly within the allotted time of 25 minutes." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"License issue/renew fee - Class D - $50.00" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Audio Exams
sections.description: Audio exams allowing an automated voice to read questions are now available to anyone without scheduling or documentation.
bullets: "Anyone can choose to take an audio exam. The exam does not need to be scheduled in advance and you do not need to present any additional documentation to be eligible." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Testing Accommodations
sections.description: Reasonable accommodations now explicitly include extended time and a designated reader, with a defined request process.
bullets: "If you have a cognitive or physical disability that would prevent you from taking a standard exam, you may request a reasonable accommodation, which could include: • Extended time • Reader" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Driver's Education Supervised Driving Hours
sections.description: The supervised driving requirement increased from 12 hours to 40 hours (30 with a skills development program) and now requires parent/guardian participation in two hours of curriculum.
bullets: "You must also complete 40 hours of supervised driving (30 hours if you completed a driver skills development program), and your parent or guardian must participate in two hours of the driver’s education curriculum (unless he/she already attended in the past five years)." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Road Test Cancellation Notice
sections.description: The cancellation/reschedule notice requirement to avoid a fee increased from 24 hours to 72 hours.
bullets: "There is no additional fee if you cancel or reschedule with more than 72 hours notice." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

"If you fail the road test, do not appear for the road test, are rejected by the examiner, or cancel your appointment with less than 72 hours notice, you will still be charged the $35 fee, which must be paid prior to a new test being booked." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Road Test Retest Waiting Period
sections.description: A new 14-day waiting period now applies after failing or missing a road test before another can be taken.
bullets: "If you fail a road test or do not appear for your scheduled test, you must wait at least 14 days before taking another test." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Rejected Road Tests Criteria
sections.description: New explicit criteria for rejecting road tests, including signs of impairment, odor of alcohol or cannabis, and presence of unsupervised children or animals.
bullets: "An odor of alcohol or cannabis is coming from you or your sponsor, including from clothing or inside the vehicle" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Out-of-State Road Test Insurance Minimums
sections.description: Minimum insurance limits for out-of-state road test vehicles increased from $20,000/$40,000 bodily injury and $5,000 property damage to $25,000/$50,000 bodily injury and $30,000 property damage.
bullets: "which are $25,000/$50,000 for bodily injury and $30,000 for property damage" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Road Test Brake Requirement
sections.description: The road test now requires an accessible parking brake (manual or electric) that is tested per a specific regulation, rather than a foot or hand brake.
bullets: "An accessible parking brake so the examiner can make an emergency stop. The parking brake can be manual or electric (push or pull button)." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

"Massachusetts regulation 540 CMR 4.04 (4) requires that parking brakes be tested by accelerating the motor to 1,200 to 1,300 RPMs with the vehicle in the lowest gear." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Donut Tire Prohibition for Road Test
sections.description: A vehicle with a limited-use spare ('donut') tire is now prohibited for use in a road test.
bullets: "A vehicle cannot be used for a road test if one of its tires has been replaced by a \"donut\" (limited use spare) tire." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Specialized Vehicle Features During Road Test
sections.description: New guidance addresses modern vehicle specialized features (backing sensors, cameras, automatic parking) which need not be disabled but for which driving skills will still be tested.
bullets: "These features substantially assist a driver with certain driving, parking, or backing skills. These devices will not need to be disabled. However, your driving skills and abilities without relying only on these specialized features will be tested." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Road Test Sponsor Limit
sections.description: Operators are now limited to sponsoring no more than three applicants within a one-year period without RMV approval.
bullets: "Operators are not allowed to sponsor more than three different applicants within a one year period without approval from the RMV Road Test Program." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Class M Road Test for Under-18 Applicants
sections.description: Applicants under 18 are no longer eligible for an RMV Class M road test and must complete the MREP basic rider course.
bullets: "If you are under 18 years old, you are not eligible for an RMV Class M road test and must complete the MREP basic rider course to get a Class M license." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Animals in Vehicle During Road Test
sections.description: The 2026 manual newly addresses service animals and emotional support animals in the road test vehicle.
bullets: "Trained service animals are allowed in the vehicle, but emotional support animals are not." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Temporary License Validity After Road Test
sections.description: The temporary license validity period after passing the road test increased from 30 days to 60 days.
bullets: "the examiner will validate your learner's permit and it will become a temporary license, valid up to 60 days (unless the permit expires before that)." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Deaf and Hard of Hearing Road Tests
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a dedicated procedure for scheduling and conducting road tests for deaf and hard of hearing applicants with interpreter arrangements.
bullets: "If you are deaf or hard of hearing, you can schedule a road test by calling 1-877-RMV-TTDD (1-877-768-8833)." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Zero Tolerance for Road Test Conduct
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a zero tolerance policy for violent or abusive conduct by road test applicants and sponsors.
bullets: "The RMV has a zero tolerance policy for violent or abusive conduct by road test applicants and sponsors." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Junior Operator Conversion Supervised Driving Hours
sections.description: The required supervised driving hours for Junior Operator license conversion increased from 12 hours to 40 hours (30 with a skills development program).
bullets: "you must log an additional 40 hours of supervised driving (30 hours if you completed a driver skills development program) as shown by a certified statement provided by a parent or guardian." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Veteran's Indicator on License
sections.description: The 2026 manual introduces the option to have the word 'Veteran' printed on a license or ID card.
bullets: "If you are a veteran of the U.S. Armed Forces and were honorably discharged, you can choose to have the word \"Veteran\" printed on your license or ID card." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Organ and Tissue Donor Registration Fund Contribution
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a $2 contribution to the Organ and Tissue Donor Registration Fund added to renewal or duplicate fees.
bullets: "to the Organ and Tissue Donor Registration Fund . This $2 will be added to the renewal or duplicate fee ." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Out-of-State Conversion Fees
sections.description: Out-of-state conversion fees were increased across all classes from the 2006 amounts.
bullets: "Class A* - $140.00 Class B* - $140.00 Class C* - $140.00 Class D* - $115.00" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"Class M only - $115.00" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Duplicate or Amended License Fee
sections.description: The fee for amending a license changed from $15 to $25, combined with the duplicate license fee.
bullets: "Duplicate or amended license - $25.00" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Required Working Driver's Side Window
sections.description: The 2026 manual newly lists a working driver's side window that moves up and down as required safety equipment.
bullets: "A working driver's side window that moves up and down" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Emergency Lights Permit Requirement
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds that emergency lights (flashing, rotating, oscillating, or strobe) are not allowed without an RMV permit.
bullets: "Emergency lights (flashing, rotating, oscillating, or strobe lights) are not allowed on a vehicle unless you get a permit from the RMV." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Car Safety Kits
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a new section recommending essential safety kit items to carry in the vehicle.
bullets: "It is recommended to carry the following items in your vehicle: • Reflective Safety Vest • Reflective Warning Triangles or LED Flares • First Aid Kit • Glass Breaker Tool • White and red cloths to tie to your vehicle during a breakdown" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Child Passenger Restraint Requirements
sections.description: The child restraint requirement changed from age/weight based on the 2006 rules to an age-eight or fifty-seven-inch height standard.
bullets: "Infants and small children must sit in federally approved child passenger restraints until they... 1. Are at least eight years old or 2. At least fifty-seven inches tall" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Minimum Tire Tread Depth
sections.description: The stated minimum tire tread depth changed from 1/16 inches in the 2006 Safety First chapter to 2/32 inches.
bullets: "Tires must have at least 2/32 inches of tread depth in the proper grooves and no fabric breaks or exposed cords." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Headphones Use While Driving
sections.description: The headphone prohibition was expanded to include wireless devices and clarifies a single earplug is allowed only for those 18 or older.
bullets: "It is illegal to wear a radio headset, headphones, or any other wired or wireless device that restricts your attention to the environment while driving. If you are 18 or older, you can use one earplug for use with a cell phone." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Loud Noise Inside Vehicle
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds guidance to avoid loud noise so emergency sirens can be heard.
bullets: "Avoid loud noise levels in your vehicle so you can hear emergency vehicle sirens." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Hands-Free Mobile Electronic Device Law
sections.description: The 2026 manual prohibits hand-held mobile device use while driving, whereas the 2006 manual explicitly permitted cellular phone use with one hand on the wheel.
bullets: "The use of hand-held mobile electronic devices (including cell phones) while driving is prohibited in Massachusetts (Chapter 90, Section 13B and Chapter 122 of the Acts of 2019)." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"Drivers 18 and older can only use mobile electronic devices in “hands­ free” mode while driving." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Penalties for Hand-Held Device Use
sections.description: The 2026 manual establishes specific escalating fines for using a hand-held mobile electronic device while driving.
bullets: "1st offense - $100 fine" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"2nd offense - $250 fine, plus mandatory completion of a distracted driving educational program" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"3rd and subsequent offenses - $500 fine, plus insurance surcharge and mandatory completion of a distracted driving program" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Vulnerable Road Users Law
sections.description: The 2026 manual introduces a Vulnerable Road Users Law requiring a four-foot safe passing distance, which is not present in the 2006 manual.
bullets: "When you pass a vulnerable road user, you must leave a safe passing distance of at least four feet between your vehicle and the road user." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Advanced Driver Assistance Systems
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a section on Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS), which did not exist in 2006.
bullets: "Many cars and trucks now come with Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS). These can make driving safer, but only if used correctly." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Drowsy Driving
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a dedicated section on drowsy driving with statistics and prevention tips not present in the 2006 manual.
bullets: "Driving while tired or drowsy can be deadly. 633 people died in 2020 from drowsy driving related crashes (source: National Highway Traffic Safety Administration)." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Safe Following Distance Rule
sections.description: The 2026 manual changes the basic following distance rule from a 2-second rule to a 3-second rule and adds specific multi-second distances for motorcycles and heavy equipment.
bullets: "Use the "three-second" rule to keep a safe distance from the vehicle in front of you." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"Keep more space (at least four seconds) behind a motorcycle than you would for another vehicle." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"Keep more space (at least ten seconds) between your vehicle and heavy equipment (for example, dump trucks, tractors)." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Tailgating Fine
sections.description: The 2026 manual specifies a fine amount for tailgating that was not stated in the 2006 manual.
bullets: "The fine for tailgating can be as high as $100." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: License Plate Visibility Requirement
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a specific requirement that the plate number must be visible from 60 feet at night.
bullets: "You must keep your license plates clean and they cannot be blocked by anything. Your plate number must be visible from 60 feet at night." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Snow and Ice Removal Requirement
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds that failing to clear ice and snow from the roof, hood, and trunk can result in a charge of negligent operation.
bullets: "It is very important that you clear the roof, hood, and trunk so ice and snow does not blow into vehicles behind you. If you do not, you can be charged with negligent operation." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Headlight Use Requirements
sections.description: The 2026 manual expands required headlight use to include driving through tunnels and clarifies daytime running lights are not sufficient.
bullets: "While driving through a tunnel" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"Whenever you use your windshield wipers (daytime running lights are not sufficient)" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Motorcycle Following Distance
sections.description: The recommended following distance behind a motorcycle was changed from four-second (vs. two-second) to four-second (vs. three-second).
bullets: "Use a four- second following distance (compared to a three-second for other motor vehicles)." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Limited Use Vehicle Safety
sections.description: A new vehicle category for limited use vehicles was added with its own licensing and operating rules.
bullets: "A limited use vehicle can have two or more wheels. It can go faster than 30 mph, but not more than 40 mph." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Low Speed Vehicle Safety
sections.description: A new vehicle category for low speed vehicles was added with its own licensing and operating rules.
bullets: "A Low Speed Vehicle (LSV) has four wheels and can only go between 20 and 25 mph. It must have a gross weight rating lower than 3,000 lbs." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Bicycle Safety Laws
sections.description: New laws place more responsibility on bicyclists, motorists, and bicycle renters, with citation authority for police.
bullets: "If a police officer sees a bicyclist commit a traffic violation, the officer can issue a citation the same way they would for a motorist." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"Companies that rent bicycles must offer helmets that meet all safety requirements for renters." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Civil Citation Hearing Filing Fee
sections.description: A new $25 filing fee is required to request a hearing to dispute a civil motor vehicle infraction.
bullets: "If you request a hearing, you must pay a $25 filing fee to the RMV." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Public Safety Surcharge on CMVIs
sections.description: A new $5 public safety surcharge is added to every civil motor vehicle infraction fine from Chapter 89 or 90.
bullets: "Every fine for a CMVI that comes from Chapter 89 or 90 of the Massachusetts General Laws will have an added $5 public safety surcharge." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: At-Fault Crash Claim Threshold
sections.description: The claim payment threshold for being considered more than 50 percent at fault was raised from more than $500 to more than $1000, and now includes bodily injury claims.
bullets: "Has paid more than $1000 for collision, limited collision, or damage to someone else’s property or has paid more than $1000 for bodily injury (if there is no collision or damage to someone else’s property over $1000 from the same incident)." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Driver Retraining Course Threshold
sections.description: The threshold for mandatory Driver Retraining was lowered from five or more surchargeable events in three years to three or more in a two-year period.
bullets: "If you get three or more surchargeable events on your driving record within a two-year period, you must complete the Massachusetts Driver Retraining Course." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Surchargeable Event Suspension Threshold
sections.description: The mandatory 60-day suspension threshold changed from seven events in a three-year period combined with the prior five-event requirement, now reflecting a three-event retraining trigger and seven-event suspension.
bullets: "If you have seven surchargeable events within a three-year period, your license will be suspended automatically for 60 days ." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Speeding Fine Surcharge
sections.description: Speeding violations now include an additional $5 public safety surcharge, raising the example fine from $180 to $185.
bullets: "The lowest penalty for driving above the speed limit is a $100 fine, plus an additional $5 public safety surcharge which is added to all speeding violations." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: License Suspension for Mobile Electronic Device Use
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds suspension penalties for junior operators convicted of using a mobile electronic device, which did not exist in 2006.
bullets: "Conviction for the Use of a Mobile Electronic Device (text or phone) (c. 90, §8M) 60 days— first offense 180 days— second offense One year— subsequent offenses" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Negligent Operation and Injury from Mobile Phone Use
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a criminal offense and suspension for negligent operation and injury from mobile phone use, absent in 2006.
bullets: "Negligent Operation and Injury from Mobile Phone Use 60 days–One year $500" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: License Suspension for Unpaid Income Tax
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds failure to pay Massachusetts income tax and bad payments to the RMV as reasons for license suspension, which were not listed in 2006.
bullets: "Have failed to pay Massachusetts income tax" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

"Have made a bad payment to the RMV (for example, you paid with a check that was later rejected or you paid with a credit card and later canceled the payment with the bank)" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Drag Racing Suspension for Drivers Over 18
sections.description: The 2026 criminal offense table adds a specific suspension and fine for drag racing by drivers over age 18 that was not in the 2006 criminal offenses table.
bullets: "Drag racing (by drivers over the age of 18) 30 days-180 days $500 - $1,000" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: OUI Penalties
sections.description: The 2026 OUI penalty fine ranges and minimum jail terms differ from the single maximum-fine figures shown in 2006.
bullets: "First Offense $500–$5,000 Maximum 2 1/2 years One Year" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"Second Offense $600–$10,000 Minimum 30 days Maximum 2 1/2 years Two years" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Ignition Interlock Device Requirement
sections.description: The 2026 manual requires an ignition interlock device after two or more OUI offenses, whereas the 2006 manual required it after a second offense.
bullets: "If you had two or more operating under the influence offenses and are eligible for a hardship license or for license reinstatement, you must have an Ignition Interlock Device." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Ignition Interlock Device Road Tests
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds procedures for scheduling a road test with a vehicle equipped with an ignition interlock device, not present in 2006.
bullets: "If you are required to use an Ignition Interlock Device and need to schedule a road test, you can schedule it online at Mass.Gov/RMV if you can provide a vehicle that has the device installed, has a center console brake, and has a seat for the sponsor." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Alcohol Highway Death Statistic
sections.description: The 2026 manual states alcohol causes about 30% of highway deaths, down from the nearly 40% figure in 2006.
bullets: "Each year in the United States, alcohol causes about 30% of all highway deaths." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Combined Alcohol and Marijuana Crash Risk
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds specific crash-risk multipliers for alcohol and combined alcohol/marijuana use not present in 2006.
bullets: "Alchohol use makes the risk of a crash five times more likely. Alcohol use combined with marijuana use makes the risk of a crash twelve times more likely." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Standard Drink Definitions
sections.description: The 2026 manual updates the standard-drink equivalents to a five-ounce glass of wine and a one-and-a-half-ounce serving of liquor, differing from the four-ounce wine and one-ounce liquor figures in 2006.
bullets: "Five ounce glass of wine" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"One and a half ounce serving of 80-proof liquor (even if mixed with a soft drink)" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Toll Violation Reasons for Nonrenewal
sections.description: The 2026 manual expands nonrenewal reasons to include multi-state E-ZPass/Fast Lane toll violations and Tobin Bridge violations beyond the 2006 Fast Lane references.
bullets: "Unpaid Massachusetts, Maine, or New Hampshire E-ZPass/Fast Lane toll violations" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"Unpaid Tobin Bridge violations" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Dangers of Speeding
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a detailed section on the dangers of speeding with pedestrian injury statistics not present in the 2006 manual.
bullets: "At a speed of 20 mph, 13% of pedestrians are seriously injured or killed in a crash. At 30 mph, that increases to 40% and at 40 mph it increases to 73%." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Thickly Settled District 25 mph Speed Limit
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds the definition of a thickly settled district and a 25 mph default speed-limit option for certain communities, not present in 2006.
bullets: "A \"thickly settled district\" is an area where buildings are fewer than 200 feet apart for a distance of 1/4 mile or more . Some communities have a thickly settled speed limit of 25 mph unless posted otherwise (per M.G.L. c90, Section 17c)." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Boston Harbor Tunnel Minimum Speed
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a 20 mph minimum speed for the Boston Harbor tunnels, not specified in 2006.
bullets: "There is a minimum speed of 20 mph in the Boston Harbor tunnels (Callahan, Sumner, and Ted Williams)." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: State Courts Against Road Rage (SCARR) Course
sections.description: The 2026 junior operator suspension provisions add a required State Courts Against Road Rage course for certain offenses, not present in 2006.
bullets: "In addition, you may be re quired to take a State Courts Against Road Rage (SCARR) course." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Flashing Yellow Arrow
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a flashing yellow arrow signal that did not exist in the 2006 manual.
bullets: "A flashing yellow arrow allows you to turn left or right in the direction of the arrow when oncoming traffic has a green light but there is a break in traffic. You must carefully determine that there is an adequate gap in the oncoming traffic and ensure that there are no pedestrians in your path before making your turn." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacon
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a new pedestrian-activated rectangular rapid flashing beacon signal.
bullets: "Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons are activated by pedestrians manually by a push button or by a pedestrian detection system. They are often located in intersections without traffic signals or at mid-block crosswalks. When activated, amber lights flash in an irregular pattern. You must stop for pedestrians when the beacon is flashing." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Pedestrian Hybrid Beacon
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a new Pedestrian Hybrid Beacon signal not present in the 2006 manual.
bullets: "A Pedestrian Hybrid Beacon (PHB) allows pedestrians to safely cross a roadway. A PHB only operates when activated by a pedestrian. When all lights are dark, you can proceed with caution. When the bottom yellow light is flashing, you must slow down. When the bottom yellow light is solid, you must prepare to stop. When the top two red lights are solid, you must stop for pedestrians. When the top two red lights are flashing, you must stop and proceed with caution if clear." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Bicycle Signals
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds bicycle-specific traffic signals not present in the 2006 manual.
bullets: "Bicycle signals are lights specifically meant for bicyclists. They display as steady red, yellow, and green bicycle symbols. When the signal is green, bicyclists can go through busy intersections while motor vehicles are stopped, protecting them from turning vehicles." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Pedestrian Countdown Timer Signals
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds new rules about numeric countdown timers at crosswalks not present in the 2006 manual.
bullets: "Some crosswalk signals include a numeric countdown timer. Pedestrians who are already in the crosswalk when the countdown reaches zero have the right-of-way." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Yielding to Pedestrians When Turning into Driveway
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a new law requiring drivers to yield to pedestrians when turning into a driveway or parking lot.
bullets: "You must yield to pedestrians when turning into a driveway or parking lot." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Shared Lane Markings (Sharrows)
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds shared lane markings (sharrows) pavement markings not present in the 2006 manual.
bullets: "Shared Lane Markings (also known as Sharrows) help bicyclists position themselves in the right location and in the right direction in a lane that is shared with motor vehicles." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"When you see a Shared Lane Marking, you must look out for the presence of bicyclists and make sure that you leave them enough space when passing." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Bicycle Lanes
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds dedicated bicycle lane markings and rules not present in the 2006 manual.
bullets: "Bicycle lanes are portions of the roadway that are intended for use by bicyclists and are typically marked by solid white lines, along with pavement markings and signs. They are five feet wide. Motor vehicles may only drive in these lanes when turning on or off the road." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Advisory Bicycle Lanes
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds advisory bicycle lanes not present in the 2006 manual.
bullets: "Advisory bicycle lanes are becoming common on streets that are too narrow for a full bicycle lane, but still have a lot of bicycle traffic. They are dashed on one or both sides to indicate that motor vehicles may use the lane space when necessary, but they must always yield to bicyclists first." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Green Pavement
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds green pavement markings for road sharing conflicts not present in the 2006 manual.
bullets: "Green pavement is used in areas where there could be road sharing conflicts between motor vehicles and bicycles. You should pay close attention and look for bicyclists before crossing green pavement. At a red light, you should not stop on green pavement." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Bus Lanes (Red Pavement)
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds red pavement bus lanes not present in the 2006 manual.
bullets: "Red pavement is used for travel lanes or station stops used by public transit systems. This includes buses, streetcars, trolleys, light-rail trains, and rapid transit fleets." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Yield Lines
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds yield line pavement markings not present in the 2006 manual.
bullets: "An intersection with a yield sign may have a YIELD line painted across it. A YIELD line looks like a series of triangles painted next to each other." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Channelizing Islands
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds channelizing islands not present in the 2006 manual.
bullets: "A channelizing island is a traffic island or pavement marking that guides traffic along certain paths and prevents operation on areas of the roadway. You cannot drive over or park a motor vehicle upon any channelizing island, unless directed to do so by a police officer." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Crossing Guards
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a dedicated section on crossing guards and warning signs not present in the 2006 manual.
bullets: "In recent years, several crossing guards in Massachusetts have been killed or injured while on duty when struck by vehicles. As a driver, you should look for warning signs that crossing guards and children may be in the road and be prepared to stop." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Civil Flaggers in Work Zones
sections.description: The 2026 manual expands work zone guidance with detailed descriptions of civil flaggers and traffic control devices not present in the 2006 manual.
bullets: "Civil Flaggers are typically used on low-speed, low-volume roadways to control traffic movement around the work area and to support other road users navigate the area." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"You must always obey directions of a traffic officer, even when they overrule signs, signals, or pavement markings." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Move-Over Law
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a Move-Over Law requiring drivers to change lanes or slow down near stationary emergency vehicles.
bullets: "The “move-over law” (Chapter 418 of the Acts of 2008) requires that if you are approaching a stationary emergency vehicle and it is displaying its flashing lights, you must proceed with caution and reduce your speed to that of a reasonable and safe speed for the road conditions." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Three-Point Turns
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds instructions for performing a three-point turn when there is not enough room for a U-turn.
bullets: "When there is not enough room for a U-turn, you may consider a three- point turn. This will put you in the opposite direction." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Backing Up
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a dedicated set of steps for backing up a vehicle.
bullets: "Use the following steps when backing up: 1. Position yourself as close as possible to the right edge of the curb." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Courtesy Crashes
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a section warning about crashes caused by drivers waving others through traffic.
bullets: "Sometimes, drivers trying to be nice can cause confusion resulting in "courtesy crashes". Waving people in through stopped traffic, or driving through traffic when someone waves you in, creates a dangerous situation and can easily result in a crash." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Passing Stopped Vehicles
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a rule prohibiting passing vehicles that are stopped or turning.
bullets: "Do not pass vehicles that are stopped or are turning (both at intersections and at non-intersections). They may be stopped for another vehicle, a person, or an animal that you cannot see." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: White Cane Law
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds the named White Cane Law and additional rules about not honking, waving on, or passing for blind pedestrians.
bullets: "The White Cane Law states that a driver must come to a complete stop when a blind pedestrian is crossing a street." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: School Bus Violation Penalty
sections.description: The penalty for a first school bus violation changed from fines up to $200 to a $250 fine plus possible license suspension.
bullets: "A first violation of this law can cause a license suspension and a $250 fine." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Funeral Processions
sections.description: The 2026 manual redefines funeral procession rules under M.G.L. Ch. 85, Section 14A, giving processions the right-of-way at intersections, whereas the 2006 manual required drivers to yield to the procession.
bullets: "Funeral processions have the right-of-way at intersections, with the EXCEPTION that they must yield to emergency vehicles with flashing lights or sirens or when directed by law enforcement." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Funeral Procession Rules
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds detailed rules for driving as part of, and around, a funeral procession, which did not exist in the 2006 manual.
bullets: "If driving as part of a funeral procession, you must:" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

"You may not drive between procession vehicles unless directed by law enforcement or you are operating an emergency vehicle with siren and flashing lights turned on." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Move-Over Law for Stationary Emergency Vehicles
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds the move-over law (Chapter 418 of the Acts of 2008) requiring drivers to change lanes or slow down when approaching stationary emergency vehicles, which is not in the 2006 manual.
bullets: "The “move-over law” (Chapter 418 of the Acts of 2008) requires you to be cautious and reduce your speed to a speed that is reasonable and safe for the road conditions when you approach a stationary emergency vehicle with flashing lights." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Bicyclist Laws
sections.description: The 2026 manual greatly expands bicyclist rules per Chapter 525 of the Acts of 2008 and adds many new specific requirements for both bicyclists and motorists not present in the 2006 edition.
bullets: "You must stay at least four feet away when passing." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"Drivers and passengers can be fined up to $100 for opening a vehicle door into an oncoming bicycle." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"A bicycle helmet approved by the U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission must be worn by a bicycle operator or passenger under 16 years old." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Bicycle Boxes
sections.description: The 2026 manual introduces bicycle boxes and two-stage left turns, which are not mentioned in the 2006 manual.
bullets: "Bicycle boxes are pavement markings that are installed at intersections to allow bicyclists a safe way to turn when approaching a red light." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Separated Bicycle Lanes
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds separated bicycle lanes (cycle tracks/protected bike lanes), which do not appear in the 2006 manual.
bullets: "Separated bicycle lanes, also know as cycle tracks and protected bike lanes, physically separate bicycle traffic from vehicular traffic." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Dutch Reach Method for Opening Doors
sections.description: The 2026 manual introduces the Dutch Reach method for opening vehicle doors safely around bicyclists, not present in the 2006 manual.
bullets: "Open the door with your far hand (the hand farther from the door). This is called the "Dutch Reach" method because it originated in the Netherlands." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Disabled Parking Fine
sections.description: The 2026 manual specifies higher and more detailed fines for HP-DV parking violations compared to the 2006 manual which only described it as a 'heavy fine.'
bullets: "The fine for a first offense is $300. The fine for wrongful use of a disabled person or veteran plate or placard is a minimum of $500." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Bus Stop Parking Fine
sections.description: The 2026 manual specifies a $100 fine for parking in a posted bus stop, a fine amount not given in the 2006 manual.
bullets: "In a bus stop (the penalty for parking in a posted bus stop is $100)" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Massachusetts Turnpike Parking Prohibition
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a specific parking prohibition and fine range for the Massachusetts Turnpike not present in the 2006 manual.
bullets: "On the Massachusetts Turnpike (fines range from $15 - $100)" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Striped Crosshatch Area Parking Prohibition
sections.description: The 2026 manual prohibits parking in a striped crosshatch area next to an HP-DV space, which is not listed in the 2006 manual.
bullets: "In a striped crosshatch area next to an HP-DV space, even if you have disability plates or a placard" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Driving Through Tunnels
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds an entirely new section on tunnel safety procedures that does not appear in the 2006 manual.
bullets: "Public Safety is a priority at MassDOT. Please follow these important safety tips when traveling through our tunnels." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Leaving the Scene of a Crash Penalties
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds specific criminal penalties for leaving the scene of a crash that are not detailed in the 2006 manual.
bullets: "Up to $5000 and imprisonment of up to 2 ½ years in jail or up to 10 years in state prison for leaving the scene after a crash causing personal injury to any person that resulted in death (Section 2 (a ½) (2))" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Drive Smart and Save - Green Driving Tips
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a section on fuel-saving and environmental driving tips not present in the 2006 manual.
bullets: "Fuel consumption increases about five percent for every five miles per hour driven above 60 mph." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Driver Removal Law
sections.description: The 2026 manual references a Driver Removal Law requiring vehicles to be moved out of travel lanes after a crash, which is not in the 2006 manual.
bullets: "If there are no injuries, the Driver Removal Law requires that vehicles be moved out of travel lanes to a safe location." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Failure to Produce License and Registration
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a specific fine for failing to produce license or registration that is not specified in the 2006 manual.
bullets: "There is a $35 fine for a first offense for the failure to produce either document." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Breakdown Safety Equipment Procedures
sections.description: The 2026 manual changes breakdown procedures to include safety vests and specific placement distances for warning triangles/LED flares, differing from the 2006 manual's generic 200-foot flare placement.
bullets: "If you stop on a two-lane road carrying traffic in both directions or on an undivided highway, place your warning triangles or LED flares: • 10 feet behind your vehicle • 100 feet behind your vehicle • 100 feet in front of your vehicle" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Stalling on Railroad Tracks Procedure
sections.description: The 2026 manual updates the railroad stall emergency procedure to use the Emergency Notification System (ENS) number and DOT grade crossing locator number, instead of the 2006 manual's instruction to simply call the police.
bullets: "If you cannot move your vehicle from the tracks, call the toll free Emergency Notification System (ENS) number that is located in the middle of the crossbuck or on the metal box near the grade crossing." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Salvage Repairable Title
sections.description: The 2006 explanation of salvage/total loss vehicle titles is absent from the 2026 manual text.
bullets: "If your vehicle becomes inoperable due to fire, vandalism, collision, theft, flood, or another event to such an extent that you or, if insured, your insurer considers it uneconomical to repair the vehicle, the vehicle will be declared a total loss." (2006 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Automotive Traffic Convention
sections.description: The 2006 list of countries whose visitors may drive on their own license is absent from the 2026 manual text.
bullets: "A foreign visitor from one of the countries or territories listed here may legally drive on the roads of the Commonwealth on his or her own country’s license" (2006 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: List of NATO Member Countries
sections.description: The 2006 list of NATO member countries is absent from the 2026 manual text.
bullets: "Belgium, Bulgaria, Canada, Czech Republic, Denmark, Estonia, France, Germany, Greece, Hungary, Iceland, Italy, Latvia, Lithuania, Luxembourg, The Netherlands, Norway, Poland, Portugal, Romania, Slovakia, Slovenia, Spain, Turkey, the United Kingdom, and the United States." (2006 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
